diagnosis.controller_interval: The 60s interval is a sleep after a tick, not a per-source guarantee. A missing/failed/ineligible continuation falls back to the 600s finished-source cadence and least-attempted rotation. The quoted 12-18 minute gaps are consistent with that fallback plus tick/host delays. In candidate source a successful, eligible persisted continuation should already request 1s sleeps; the provided receipts do NOT contain fetch-state flags, controller result/error timestamps or loop invocations, so which hosted gate failed cannot be established from them alone.
diagnosis.controller_change: Explicit newest-session continuations outrank ordinary due sources. Reuse the already validated terminal readback with this tick's admitted adapter bindings instead of fetching another readback and registry after persistence. Failed/degraded/unoffered sources retain existing fail-closed cadence gates.
diagnosis.index_policy: Index is freshly read every pull (including cache hits), at 504KB/0.308s modelled remote cost. It is already size-bounded at 8MiB and is not the dominant read; no TTL that could hide a new run was introduced.
diagnosis.hosted_gap_followup: Authorized hosted verifier must correlate source receipts with controller tick results and fetch_state.collector_outcome.observed for the exact deployed identity. This author has no VM/SSH/deployment authority and makes no claim of having proved the historical gap cause.

implementation.cache: Process-local bounded LRU shared by newly constructed adapters/transports; 16 entries and 64MiB encoded metadata. No persisted trust marker or new state file. Full verification on miss, absent digest, changed run/index identity/digest or restart. HTTP host/token namespace, storage root and source isolate reuse. Metadata admitted only after source/schema/time/status/item coverage/bundle digest verification and agreement with the live index digest.
implementation.eviction: LRU/byte bound; replaced run identity/digest evicts its old entry after full verification; prior trading sessions are evicted when a newer session is selected. Same-session runs remain bounded and available for omitted-instrument union/rollback safety.
implementation.verification: Each delivered raw item still downloads and verifies its hash/declared size; existing raw-to-native-row and record contract checks run before persistence and acknowledgement.
implementation.rollback: Existing latest_priority.json and resume cursor formats unchanged. Actual bee62bc29 and 0940f6248 reader tests parse new acknowledgements.
implementation.producer_digest_contract: deploy/collector/collector_stack/bundle.py::_update_index publishes bundle_sha256 for every run; absent legacy digests intentionally miss the cache.

model_limits: Synthetic valid native bundles padded with JSON whitespace to the exact supplied encoded sizes, four same-session runs per source and 1721-entry index. Real in-process HTTP controller/API/scheduler, evidence/config JSONL, SQLite queue, raw/normalized and latest snapshot persistence. 3MB/s and 0.14/0.19s fresh connections are virtual; actual CPU/disk time is charged, affinity limited to two cores. This is not hosted network/PostgreSQL proof and does not reproduce host load 15-34.
